parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, no documented police targeting, violence or abuses; official report clean. But no SOGI discrimination ban, no recognition, Catholic-conservative disapproval, near-zero visibility. Friction and thin recourse, not hostility: upper Elevated.

Statute criminalises same-sex conduct, transition itself and LGBTQ organising (5-20 years), enforced by documented nationwide arrests and imprisonments. State-directed witch-hunt, collapse of care, no recourse; outed trans visitor faces near-certain custody.

State-imposed universal exposure: strip-searches, custody and single-sex-space rules keyed to birth sex, hospital ward exclusion linked to a death, biological-sex equality ruling and code in force. Efficient institutions enforce hostile policy; remedy unrealised.

No entry or document obstacle and anti-discrimination law covering gender identity, but official ministerial hostility, regressive recognition-ban bills, lethal 2022 bar attack with no progress after, and unfavourable public opinion.

No trans offence, constitution bars SOGI discrimination, state-backed trans programme, legal gender change, pride; historic police crackdowns on presentation are dated (2001/2004). Current police posture, facilities and care access for visitors undocumented.
